description: 한국철도공사_열차운임 및 시간표(열차 및 전철) [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도공사. 한국철도공사의 ‘열차운임 및 시간표(열차 및 전철)’ 데이터는 2021년 5월 기준으로, 전국의 주요 열차와 전철의 운임(요금)과 운행 시각표를 표 형식으로 제공하는 공식 자료입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도공사. Its tags are 열차운임 구조, 시간표 패턴, 노선별 요금 차이, 운행시간 변화, 서비스 운영 효율성. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-09-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
